authors.name: Quantiviq Research
authors.bio: Quantiviq Research publishes original analysis on AI-native business transformation — operating models, economics, governance and execution. Our analysis is grounded in verified primary research (McKinsey, BCG, Gartner, Deloitte, NIST, peer-reviewed studies) and in Quantiviq's own demonstrated engineering work on agentic systems and organizational simulators. Every claim traces to a cited source; every framework is original synthesis.
